title: Bias-Aware Agent: Enhancing Fairness in AI-Driven Knowledge Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the agent's ability to detect bias in retrieved news articles using a pre-trained text classification tool (Dbias trained on the MBAD dataset). The system classifies articles as 'biased' or 'unbiased' in response to queries specifically designed to elicit polarized socio-political topics (e.g., abortion, climate change, political figures, and social movements).
